entities.name: Bernard Fergusson, Baron Ballantrae
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brigadier Bernard Edward Fergusson, Baron Ballantrae, was a British Army officer and military historian who served as the tenth governor-general of New Zealand from 1962 to 1967. He was the last British-born person to hold the position.
